title: Oval diamond and baguette necklace, platinum
subtitle: An oval diamond's defining quality is its range — fire from the facets, and length from the shape. The Première was built to extend that reach: baguette-cut diamonds graduate outward from the center in tiers angled to follow the collarbone, with Ashoka and square-cut diamonds at the perimeter to amplify the light moving through the whole piece. Every element exists in service of the oval at center.
